methods_quotes.q: Disparity RRs and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using White persons as the reference population
Because of high interannual variability in drowning death rates, 5-year moving averages in rates and RRs were calculated to visualize temporal trends.
Crude death rates (per 100,000 population) were calculated using 1999–2019 U.S. Census bridged-race population estimates.
Joinpoint regression (version 4.7.0.0; National Cancer Institute) was used to describe trends and changes in trends in annual drowning death rates and RRs.
